title: SonarQube Code Quality & Security
description: Analyze code quality and security with SonarQube — search issues and hotspots, check quality gates, read measures, and analyze snippets — via the official SonarQube MCP server.

env_vars.name: SONARQUBE_TOKEN
env_vars.description: SonarQube user token (USER type for SonarQube Server). Authenticates all requests; pass via env, never inline in args (doctrine #6).

env_vars.name: SONARQUBE_ORG
env_vars.description: SonarQube Cloud organization key. Required for SonarQube Cloud; its presence selects Cloud over Server.

env_vars.name: SONARQUBE_URL
env_vars.description: SonarQube Server URL (required for Server), or a custom Cloud URL (e.g. https://sonarqube.us for Cloud US).

env_vars.name: SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY
env_vars.description: Set to `true` to enable read-only mode, disabling all write operations (e.g. changing issue status).

env_vars.name: SONARQUBE_PROJECT_KEY
env_vars.description: Optional default project key; when set, tools that need a project key use it automatically.

auth.recipe: generate a SonarQube user token; for SonarQube Cloud set SONARQUBE_TOKEN + SONARQUBE_ORG, for SonarQube Server set SONARQUBE_TOKEN + SONARQUBE_URL; add SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY=true for analysis-only access.

sample_tools.name: search_sonar_issues_in_projects
sample_tools.summary: Search issues across projects with severity and quality filters.

sample_tools.name: analyze_code_snippet
sample_tools.summary: Analyze file content with SonarQube analyzers for quality and security issues.

sample_tools.name: get_project_quality_gate_status
sample_tools.summary: Get the Quality Gate status for a project.

sample_tools.name: search_security_hotspots
sample_tools.summary: Search for Security Hotspots in a project.

sample_tools.name: get_component_measures
sample_tools.summary: Get measures (ncloc, coverage, complexity, …) for a component.

sample_tools.name: list_quality_gates
sample_tools.summary: List all quality gates in the SonarQube instance.

known_limitations: Requires a SonarQube user token (SONARQUBE_TOKEN); for SonarQube Cloud also set SONARQUBE_ORG, for SonarQube Server set SONARQUBE_URL. Without valid credentials the tools return an auth error.
Distributed as a Docker image (sonarsource/sonarqube-mcp) — Docker (or another OCI runtime) must be installed and running; a standalone JAR is also published.

Tool availability depends on the connected edition and entitlements — dependency-risk, advanced-analysis, enterprise, and system tools require specific SonarQube Server/Cloud tiers; mount your project at /app/mcp-workspace to keep file content out of the agent context.
Mutating tools (change_sonar_issue_status, change_security_hotspot_status, create_webhook) exist — set SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY=true to disable all write operations.

Destructive-action audit (X2.18): no tool matches destructive name patterns (destructive_tools is empty); write operations are gated behind SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY and the trust policy's allowDestructive:false.

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `sonarsource`: { command: docker, args: [run, --init, -i, --rm, -e, SONARQUBE_TOKEN, -e, SONARQUBE_ORG, sonarsource/sonarqube-mcp], env: { SONARQUBE_TOKEN: "...", SONARQUBE_ORG: "..." } }.
client_install.cursor: Settings → MCP → Add: name `sonarsource`, command `docker run --init -i --rm -e SONARQUBE_TOKEN -e SONARQUBE_ORG sonarsource/sonarqube-mcp`; set SONARQUBE_TOKEN + SONARQUBE_ORG in the env.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `sonarsource` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview); supply SONARQUBE_TOKEN (+ SONARQUBE_ORG or SONARQUBE_URL) via inputs.
